title: RLGPA: A Reinforcement Learning-Guided Granularity Planning Attack for Decision-Based Sparse Adversarial Examples
abstract: arXiv:2611.07512v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Decision-based sparse attacks must reduce perturbation support using only the victim's predicted label. The best restoration strategy varies as support contracts: coarse removal works early, while tail states need finer, history-aware tests. We propose RLGPA, an online reinforcement learning method that schedules support-reduction executors and their granularity under a hard query budget. A masked Dueling Double DQN selects among seven stable policy--scale actions; each action produces support-relative restoration groups that are rebuilt after every macro decision. A feasibility-preserving executor commits only adversarial restorations and feeds support gain and query cost back to the planner. Under the matched top-1-label oracle, RLGPA reaches 61\% targeted ASR at sparsity 0.01 on CIFAR-10 (vs. 25\% SparseEvo, 0\% Pointwise), and 75.5\%/73.0\% on ResNet50/ViT at sparsity 0.005 (vs. 29.0\%/15.5\%). translated_title: RLGPA：一种用于基于决策的稀疏对抗样本的强化学习引导粒度规划攻击
translated_abstract: 基于决策的稀疏攻击必须仅利用受害模型预测的标签来减少扰动的支撑集。随着支撑集不断收缩，最佳的恢复策略也随之变化：粗粒度的删除在早期有效，而尾部状态则需要更精细、具备历史感知能力的测试。我们提出RLGPA，这是一种在线强化学习方法，能够在严格的查询预算下调度支撑集缩减执行器及其操作粒度。一个带掩码的对偶双重DQN（Dueling Double DQN）在七个稳定的策略-尺度动作中进行选择；每个动作都会生成与支撑集相关的恢复组，并在每次宏观决策后重新构建。一个保持可行性的执行器只提交保持对抗性的恢复结果，并将支撑集增益和查询成本反馈给规划器。在匹配的top-1标签预言机条件下，RLGPA在CIFAR-10上稀疏度为0.01时达到61%的定向攻击成功率（相比之下SparseEvo为25%，Pointwise为0%），在ResNet50/ViT上稀疏度为0.005时分别达到75.5%/73.0%（相比之下为29.0%/15.5%）。固定探针测试将中位数L0（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出RLGPA，一种利用在线强化学习在查询预算约束下自适应调度不同粒度支撑集缩减策略的方法，在基于决策的稀疏对抗攻击中显著超越现有方法（CIFAR-10上定向攻击成功率达61%，ResNet50/ViT上达75.5%/73.0%）。
en_tdlr: RLGPA employs online reinforcement learning to adaptively schedule support-reduction executors and their granularities under a hard query budget, substantially outperforming existing decision-based sparse adversarial attacks (achieving 61% targeted ASR on CIFAR-10 and 75.5%/73.0% on ResNet50/ViT).
